newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance helps drive up Delhi share prices.
newsitem.headline: Reliance helps drive up Delhi share prices.

text.p: Reliance Industries powered Delhi share prices to a higher close on Tuesday amid expectations the company might announce a bonus share issue, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 8.61 points higher at 811.10.
Reliance surged 7.10 rupees to 317.50 on heavy buying by foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
"Reliance Industries mainly remained at the centre of the day's activity on rumours of a bonus share issue," said one broker.
Traders said share prices were widely expected to climb higher.
"The buoyancy has returned to the market as selling by profit takers was easily absorbed," Marinder Vashisht of brokers Fairdeal Investments said.

Ranbaxy Laboratories closed 10.50 rupees higher at 588.00. During the day the pharmaceuticals maker announced that 1996/97 (April-March) net profit rose to 1.54 billion rupees from 1.35 billion in the previous year.
Nestle India rose six rupees to 270.
Larsen and Toubro rose 4.50 rupees to 224.75.
